{{dablink|For other uses of the word "silver," see [[Silver]].}}
The '''silver ring''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of [[Elayne Trakand]]. It was recently held by [[Ispan Shefar]], but had it taken upon her capture as a Black sister.

==Appearance==
The ring is silver and worked in braided spirals.

==Use==
The ring is a [[sleepweaver]], allowing the user to enter ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' by channeling Spirit into it.{{ref/book|11|15}}
